subject: slender elf archer in a green hooded cloak with a tall recurve longbow in the left hand and a quiver on the back
motion: drawing the bow fully and loosing an arrow
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: a streaking arrow with a thin green magic trail

plan.source: Three-quarter facing right; right hand holds tall recurve bow down and forward; left hand raised near the quiver behind head; feet staggered with left forward; head looking right.

frames.pose: Anticipation: torso leans slightly toward target; right arm dips the bow a notch forward; left hand reaches back to quiver to grab an arrow; head right; left foot forward planted, right back planted.

Key: torso leans back and opens; right arm extends, bow up at chest height to screen-right; left hand draws string to cheek with arrow nocked; head sights along arrow; left foot planted, right light but planted.
Release: left fingers open past cheek; right arm steadies as bow snaps; torso rotates into shot; head tracks right; both feet planted.
frames.effect: Arrow streaks off screen-right from bow, thin green magic trail lagging; small pale arc at bow tips showing snap.

frames.pose: Recovery: torso returns upright; right arm lowers bow toward vertical at side; left hand drops then starts lifting back toward quiver; head relaxes; feet as before, weight centered.
